rv.q: While technically impressive, this filmic device hobbles the pace and highlights a lack of dramatic drive in the writing.
Young director Sain handles the play confidently, and together with intimacy coordinator Robbie Taylor Hunt stages a sex scene as gratifyingly mundane as I’ve seen on stage.

López proved with The Inheritance that he is a worthy successor to Tony Kushner and though this is a work more in miniature, both in length, cast size, and scope, it still has that richness of tone and thought that only a master craftsman can shape.

cn.t: López's intimate chamber piece about urban gay loneliness resonates deeply in this sensitive UK premiere, featuring impressive design and fine performances that bring new depth to the playwright's pre-Inheritance work.
